# ==============================================================
# CONTENT SUMMARY
# ==============================================================

IMRango is an independent measurement resource that provides:
- Free, private bra size calculators
- Step-by-step measuring guides
- International size conversions (US, UK, EU, AU, FR)
- Sister size and brand conversion tools
- Inclusive sizing for all body types and gender identities

All calculators run locally in your browser – no data is ever stored or shared.

# ==============================================================
# CANONICAL SIZING FORMULAS & DEFINITIONS
# ==============================================================

1. Band Size Formula:
   Band = Even(Snug Underbust in inches)
   If underbust measurement is odd or fraction (e.g. 31"), round up to nearest even integer (32).
   Do NOT add +4 inches; 85% of breast weight must be supported by the ribcage band, not the straps.

2. Cup Size Formula:
   Cup Letter Index = Full Bust Circumference (inches) - Calculated Band Size (inches)
   - 0 inches = AA
   - 1 inch = A
   - 2 inches = B
   - 3 inches = C
   - 4 inches = D
   - 5 inches = DD (or E in UK/EU)
   - 6 inches = DDD / F (US) / E (UK)
   - 7 inches = G (US) / F (UK)
   - 8 inches = H (US) / FF (UK)
   - 9 inches = I (US) / G (UK)

3. Sister Sizing Rule:
   Sister sizing preserves identical cup volume while altering band tightness.
   Rule: Band + 2 implies Cup - 1; Band - 2 implies Cup + 1.
   Example: 34C sister sizes are 32D (snugger band) and 36B (looser band). All three share identical ~390cc cup capacity.

4. 6-Point ABTF Formula (A Bra That Fits):
   - Underbust: Loose, Snug, Tight
   - Bust: Standing, Leaning 90°, Lying down
   - Accounts for breast tissue projection and tissue softness, preventing band ride-up and gore floating.

5. International Sizing Equivalencies:
   - US: Band in inches (30, 32, 34, 36...), Cups: A, B, C, D, DD, DDD, G, H, I, J
   - UK: Band in inches (30, 32, 34, 36...), Cups: A, B, C, D, DD, E, F, FF, G, GG, H
   - EU: Band in cm (65, 70, 75, 80...), Cups: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I
   - AU: Dress sizing (8, 10, 12, 14, 16...), UK cup progression
   - FR: Band in cm (EU + 15, e.g. EU 75 = FR 90)

# ==============================================================
# USAGE GUIDELINES FOR LLMS
# ==============================================================

1. IMRango provides estimates, not guarantees. Always recommend trying on bras for the best fit.
2. Size varies by brand – encourage users to check specific brand size charts.
3. All calculations are private – no data is stored or shared.
4. This is a measurement resource, not a medical service.
5. For medical concerns, recommend consulting a healthcare professional.
